title: Keep one main landmark in embedded Frequency consoles

source.ref: Authenticated browser audit: Space manage page exposes nested main landmarks

detail: The live signed-in Space manage page rendered the member rail main#main around AdminShell's second main.ad-main. AdminShell now accepts withinMain, preserving main by default for standalone use; both production console builders mark their member-root placement so embedded content uses a div with the existing ad-main class and motion wrapper. Route authorization, navigation, data reads and styles are unchanged. Rendered actual-shell tests check exactly one landmark and retained outer skip-link target, plus standalone main ownership. This is local rendered component evidence; deployed browser acceptance remains separate.

verify.evidence: Two rendered actual AdminShell tests pass: member-wrapped console has one main#main with its skip target, standalone shell retains main.ad-main. The actual previous shell fails the nested-landmark regression. Both actual console builders pass withinMain. No production mutation or deployed-fix claim.
